mapper.insert: INSERT dbo.Follow (UserId, StoryId) SELECT #{userId}, #{storyId} WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Follow WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK) WHERE UserId = #{userId} AND StoryId = #{storyId})
mapper.delete: DELETE dbo.Follow WHERE UserId = #{userId} AND StoryId = #{storyId}
mapper.select: SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Follow WHERE UserId = #{userId} AND StoryId = #{storyId}) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
SELECT FollowCount FROM dbo.Story WHERE StoryId = #{storyId}

SELECT
JOIN dbo.Follow f ON f.StoryId = s.StoryId AND f.UserId = #{userId} ORDER BY s.LastChapterAt DESC, s.StoryId DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{size} ROWS ONLY
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.Follow f JOIN dbo.vw_PublicStory s ON s.StoryId = f.StoryId WHERE f.UserId = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT dbo.AuthorFollow (FollowerId, AuthorId) SELECT #{followerId}, #{authorId} WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.AuthorFollow WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK) WHERE FollowerId = #{followerId} AND AuthorId = #{authorId})
mapper.delete: DELETE dbo.AuthorFollow WHERE FollowerId = #{followerId} AND AuthorId = #{authorId}
mapper.select: SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.AuthorFollow WHERE FollowerId = #{followerId} AND AuthorId = #{authorId}) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
SELECT FollowerCount FROM dbo.Author WHERE UserId = #{authorId}

SELECT a.UserId AS AuthorId, a.PenName, u.AvatarUrl, a.IsVerified, a.FollowerCount, af.CreatedAt AS FollowedAt FROM dbo.AuthorFollow af JOIN dbo.Author a ON a.UserId = af.AuthorId JOIN dbo.[User] u ON u.UserId = a.UserId WHERE af.FollowerId = #{followerId} ORDER BY af.CreatedAt DESC, a.UserId DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{size} ROWS ONLY
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dbo.AuthorFollow WHERE FollowerId = #{followerId}
